highlights: The weather card's rain row shows tomorrow's rain whenever enough is coming to change watering, even when it also rains today, and no longer prints a made-up 0% chance
Put-up: when a Save fails, the message now scrolls into view above the Save button instead of hiding under it
Put-up: after "already saved earlier", closing the sheet gives you a clean one next time instead of staying stuck on the old item
A watering logged from Snap, a container's quick log or by voice records a normal water amount
Editing only the note on a watering no longer marks its water amount as your choice
A care profile with a feeding interval of zero falls back to that plant's usual interval instead of asking every day
